t: This is St Peter's in Wapping Lane, a Grade I listed Anglican church, which is the highest grade of listing. It was designed by Frederick Hyde Pownall, a British architect. Pownall was County Surveyor for Middlesex for about forty-five years, and he designed both Anglican and Roman Catholic churches. So this church comes from someone who spent a long career shaping buildings across the county, and it is now recognised as one of the country's most significant.
